 Will Draymond Green play? Final injury status for Warriors vs. Mavericks revealed 
 2026-11-18 23:49 
 Draymond Green (elbow) is available for the Warriors against the Mavericks, but will be sidelined on Thursday in Memphis against the Grizzlies.
 Credit: Getty Images via AFP - Scanpix

 As they continue their long five-game road trip on Wednesday in Dallas, the Warriors announced that Green will be available to play.
 However, Steve Kerr revealed in his pregame speech that the former NBA star will rest and sit out their upcoming Thursday tilt against the Memphis Grizzlies.
 Draymond Green available vs. Mavs, to sit out against Grizzlies
 Draymond Green has been dealing with right elbow soreness. Despite his availability to play this Wednesday, the Golden State Warriors are still being cautious about his injured status.
 Charles Bassey and Georges Niang are set to earn increased roles with Green not playing against the Memphis Grizzlies.
 Through 12 games so far in this new NBA regular season, Green is averaging 3.2 points, 5.0 rebounds, and 6.9 assists in 25.8 minutes for Golden State.
 With Green cleared to play, the Warriors will look to snap their three-game losing streak as they face the Mavs in Dallas.
